full_analysis:
## Market Structure & Technical Context

CADJPY exhibits a textbook Head & Shoulders distribution pattern on the D1 timeframe, characterized by a distinct head peaking at 113.66 and a declining right shoulder structure that points to active trend exhaustion. With the price currently resting at 111.34 just above the critical neckline at 110.84, sellers are positioned to accelerate downside momentum toward the algorithmic target of 108.02. 

The technical evidence strongly supports this bearish continuation, highlighted by an oversold RSI reading of 25.2% signaling heavy selling pressure alongside a bearish EMA alignment where the EMA20 at 112.02 sits firmly below the EMA50 at 112.25. The daily Average True Range (ATR) of 0.62 provides adequate breathing room for the 3.1x ATR stop-loss placed at 113.25, ensuring clean trade geometry.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 113.66 (Pattern Head) and 112.88 (Right Shoulder rejection level)
- **Support**: 110.84 (Neckline support defining the breakdown boundary)

## Invalidation Level

A decisive daily candle close above the 113.25 stop-loss level completely invalidates the Head & Shoulders pattern and signals structural continuation of the broader prior bull trend.

## Macro & Flow Context

Persistent Middle East shipping attacks and elevated oil prices around $92 continue to inject volatility into global currency markets, directly influencing commodity-linked currencies like the Canadian Dollar. CFD physics confirm laminar flow with aligned bearish momentum, making this downside breakout setup technically robust.
